questions.stem: Scenario S3, multi-agent research system. One of four research subagents is refused access to a source, and the coordinator cancels the run and tells the user that it failed. Which handling fits?

options.text: Retry the refused one again and again until the door finally opens, then continue
options.says: Ruled out because "a permission error or an invalid query fails again the same way, and the subagent reports it at once".

options.text: Ask the user to restart the whole run after the source has been fixed
options.says: Ruled out because "terminating on a single failure throws away the work of the other subagents".

options.text: Fill the closed gap with a plausible summary drawn from the model's own general knowledge
options.says: Ruled out because the plan for a failure with nothing to try is "Say what is missing, and do not guess".

options.text: Carry on with the other three and log the closed topic as a gap, with a way to reopen it
options.says: Terminating on one failure wastes the other work, and a refusal is recorded as a gap with the way to get access.

origin.section: Handle a failure at the lowest layer that can fix it

questions.stem: Scenario S3, multi-agent research system. A subagent stops at its maxTurns limit after doing good work. What does the parent receive?

options.text: An error, with the output discarded and the task started again
options.says: Ruled out because "the parent receives its output flagged as partial", and nothing is discarded.

options.text: Nothing, until the user raises the limit and runs it again
options.says: Ruled out because "Resuming is cheaper than starting a fresh subagent on the same task when the work so far is good", and no one has to rerun it.

options.text: The output flagged as partial, which a later resume continues
options.says: The output comes back marked as partial, and a custom subagent keeps its history so that it can be resumed.

options.text: The output without a flag, which looks like a finished answer
options.says: Ruled out because the marker exists so that "Claude knows the run is unfinished".

origin.section: Partial results are marked, not hidden and not discarded

questions.stem: Scenario S3, multi-agent research system. During a run on one subject, a subagent's source stops answering after supplying three of the ten items that were expected. What should the coordinator do with the three?

options.text: Discard the three and report the subject as having no findings
options.says: Ruled out because "Discarding them wastes work the subagent did".

options.text: Present the three to readers as the subject's complete answer
options.says: Ruled out because "presenting them as the full answer is the silent suppression of page 1 in another form".

options.text: Wait and rerun the lookup until all ten items have arrived
options.says: Ruled out because "An alternative is tried once, within the bounded rounds of module 46, and a second failure becomes a gap".

options.text: Keep them, flagged as partly evidenced, with the gap stated
options.says: The three results are kept and labelled, with the gap stated.

origin.section: Partial results are marked, not hidden and not discarded
